tagline: Slices through his enemies with precise strikes
hype: In a flurry of slashes, Juggernaut cuts down his foes. Sprinting and spinning into battle with reckless abandon, and nearly invincible once he is able to begin his assault, stopping Juggernaut can often be just as difficult as surviving him.
bio: No one has ever seen the face hidden beneath the mask of Yurnero the Juggernaut. It is only speculation that he even has one. For defying a corrupt lord, Yurnero was exiled from the ancient Isle of Masks--a punishment that saved his life. The isle soon after vanished beneath the waves in a night of vengeful magic. He alone remains to carry on the Isle's long Juggernaut tradition, one of ritual and swordplay. The last practitioner of the art, Yurnero's confidence and courage are the result of endless practice; his inventive bladework proves that he has never stopped challenging himself. Still, his motives are as unreadable as his expression. For a hero who has lost everything twice over, he fights as if victory is a foregone conclusion.

abilities.name: juggernaut_blade_fury
abilities.title: Blade Fury
abilities.desc: Causes a bladestorm of destructive force around Juggernaut, rendering him debuff immune with 80% magic resistance and dealing damage every 0.2s to nearby enemy units. Applies a basic dispel at the start and end of the spin. DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
abilities.lore: Yurnero's renowned katana techniques are feared by warriors and sorcerors alike.
notes: You can use items during Blade Fury.
abilities.scepter: Allows Juggernaut to attack his enemies during Blade Fury even while moving. These attacks deal 75% damage and Item Potency.

abilities.name: juggernaut_healing_ward
abilities.title: Healing Ward
abilities.desc: Summons a Healing Ward which heals all nearby allied units, based on their max health. The Healing Ward moves at 325 movement speed after being summoned. Lasts 18 / 20 / 22 / 24 seconds.
abilities.lore: Of the rituals learned at the Isle of Masks, tending wounds with a bit of voodoo magic has proven to be quite useful.
notes: The Healing Ward can be controlled.
Multiple Healing Wards do not stack.

abilities.name: juggernaut_blade_dance
abilities.title: Blade Dance
abilities.desc: Gives Juggernaut a chance to deal critical damage with Blade Fury and on each attack.
abilities.lore: The last remnant of his heritage's commitment to bladework, Yurnero ensures that the style is remembered.

abilities.name: juggernaut_bladeform
abilities.title: Bladeform
abilities.desc: Juggernaut gains a stack of Bladeform every 2s that Juggernaut does not take damage. Each stack grants bonus base Agility and Movement Speed. Stacks fade after 2s upon taking any damage.
notes: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

abilities.name: juggernaut_omni_slash
abilities.title: Omnislash
abilities.desc: Juggernaut leaps towards the target enemy unit and then slashes it. Juggernaut continues to jump slash nearby random enemies (including the previously slashed enemy) until the duration ends or there are no enemies nearby. Jump rate is dependent on Juggernaut's attack speed. Juggernaut is invulnerable and has increased attack speed during Omnislash. DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
abilities.lore: 'The fruits of discipline; with practice comes strength.'
notes: You can use items during Omnislash.
